name: inclusion-demand
cmd: set -e; bash lane-e-preflight/apply.sh; bash lane-e-demand/apply.sh; bash lane-e-flags/apply.sh; bash research/track-m/prepare-vendors.sh; bun install --frozen-lockfile >/dev/null; cp row-analysis/inspect-inclusions.ts research/mldr-incl/inspect-inclusions.ts; work=$(mktemp -d); for name in early-6000-before row-first-2700-after; do mkdir "$work/$name"; tar -xzf "row-archives/$name/receipts.tar.gz" -C "$work/$name"; for side in before after; do bun research/mldr-incl/inspect-inclusions.ts "$work/$name/$side/capture.json.gz" "$name-$side"; done; done
